scope: Restless Ghost destination chunks and worn-equipment requirement; not approval of every imported branch or travel route

wiki.title: The Restless Ghost
reviewedFacts: Father Urhney is west in Lumbridge Swamp and supplies the amulet during the quest.
The ghostspeak amulet must be equipped to communicate with the ghost.
The altar skeleton can be avoided; killing it is not required.
The skull is obtained in the Wizards' Tower basement and returned to the graveyard coffin.

discrepancies.finding: Recovery tooltip says south east; its own action and coordinates, plus the reviewed Wiki, place Urhney west.
discrepancies.decision: Use the reviewed western location; do not promote the tooltip.

discrepancies.finding: The task names the ghost but does not encode the worn-amulet condition.
discrepancies.decision: Keep the explicit equipped requirement from Quest Helper, confirmed by Wiki, and the existing Fate Neck T1 gate.

discrepancies.finding: The task does not encode the distinction between fighting and avoiding the skeleton.
discrepancies.decision: Retain the existing no-fighting route, supported by Quest Helper and Wiki.

discrepancies.finding: Quest Helper says search the coffin; the public guide and Wiki describe using the skull on it.
discrepancies.decision: Destination agreement is reviewed; retain existing Wiki-backed public instruction. Do not infer interaction equivalence from the shared coordinates.
